name: nebula-docs-starter-empty
description: Minimal Nebula Docs starter — the smallest valid tenant repo. `nebula init --empty` produces this shape; tenants extend it with their own content.

scripts.dev: echo 'Run from CLI: pnpm --filter @nebula-docs/cli dev tenants/nebula-docs-starter-empty'
scripts.build: echo 'Run from CLI: pnpm --filter @nebula-docs/cli build tenants/nebula-docs-starter-empty'
